jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Capability Lead (f/m/d) you coordinate and review CAPA and 3i activities by aligning with project managers on commitments, ensuring complete documentation, summarizing review outcomes, and following up on agreed actions while supporting colleagues in using the tools and processes correctly. In parallel, you contribute to the global SAP S/4HANA transformation by driving harmonized and standardized project execution practices, testing and validating implemented solutions, and collaborating closely with business, IT, and implementation partners to ensure solutions meet business requirements.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Ensure the correct application of the CAPA process for nonconformances, risks, or customer complaints, including managing database access and conducting training sessions
* Prepare 3i reviews, finalize the acceptance list and initiate the award payments together with the 3i - Commission members
* Collect ideas and initiate change requests for CAPA / 3i tools, supporting implementation and training for users
* Prepare regular overviews of CAPA / 3i process successes and summarize KPI achievement to management and at share point
* Drive the operational change in the context of implementation of quality processes within SAP by involving and coordinating with the technical experts to ensure proper integration of project related processes with other SAP modules
* Manage Projects capability across multiple rollout entities, understanding necessary organizational changes and identify process improvement opportunities by a strong collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications

What You Bring

* Completed a technical university or university of applied sciences degree in mechanical engineering or a comparable field and a strong knowledge of SAP based processes and tools
* Several years of professional experience in quality and process management, a strong understanding of end-to-end Project processes, and Change Management experience is a plus
* Excellent team collaboration, communication, and analytical skills as well as commitment to responsibilities and ownership of tasks
* Structured work approach, focus on meeting deadlines, and ability to remain calm in critical discussions, steering them toward solutions
* Experience in priority handling and the ability to balance global standardization with local execution needs 
* Fluency in English, written and spoken 

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As Head of Service Operations Controlling, you will have full responsibility for all controlling and reporting activities related to Europe and Africa Service Operations. 
This includes financial planning, forecasting, actual reporting, and analysis for multiple countries in Europe and Africa. You will directly lead a team of employees in Germany and coordinate with local business partner in the countries to ensure accurate and timely reporting & controlling. 
In this position you are responsible to steer the operational day-to-day controlling activities for field service & tooling cost centers. You will act as a business partner to Service Operations leadership, providing in-depth financial analysis, preparing scenario models for strategic decisions, and assessing risks for ongoing and new projects. You will also drive the implementation of process standardization, automation, and digitalization initiatives (including AI).

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Team Leadership & Development: Manage a team of up to 8 employees in Germany and a network of local business partner in several countries. Define Roles & Responsibilities set clear performance targets, conduct regular 1:1s, organize team workshops, and oversee talent development.
* Financials Planning, Forecast and actual reporting of Order Entry, Revenue, Revenue Margin and Free Cash Flow for Service Operations internal business with New Unit, On-shore Projects and other Business Areas
* Financial Planning, Reporting & Analysis: Own the annual budget process, prepare monthly forecast and actual reporting for Service Operations cost centers, Headcount and Capex. Consolidate data from all countries, analyze cost variances, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare and present management reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses for senior leadership.
* Ensure accurate tracking and operational management of all cost centers, collaborate with Service Operations Management and EU&AF Business Controlling
* Process Optimization & Digitalization: Map and standardize controlling processes across countries. Identify manual tasks and drive automation using SAP enhancements, RPA bots, and Power BI dashboards. Lead digitalization projects, including AI implementation for predictive analytics and reporting.
* Compliance & Internal Controls: Implement and monitor internal controls to ensure compliance with company policies, SOX requirements, and local regulations.

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a comparable field, or equivalent qualification (e.g., Siemens commercial apprenticeship combined with extensive professional experience), with long-term, in-depth experience in Business Controlling or Finance, particularly in closing, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Experience in Finance / BC, Sales or Project Management in Gas Services or with one of the Gas Services Execution Units Central or Distributed is preferred with basic understanding of the underlying business models and technical Siemens Energy products and solutions
* Proven leadership experience and ability to lead teams effectively in a matrix organization
* Advanced experience in SAP and Siemens Energy reporting tools (e.g. Esprit, EPM+, SAC, Dash) and experience in data analytics and visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, think-cell etc., Alteryx)

As Head of Product Excellence (f/m/d) for the Steam Turbine and Generator (STG) business no day will look the same. * Verification of completeness, quality and timely availability of review documentation to enable equal access to information for all reviewers
* Facilitation and moderation of reviews including validation of reviewer presence, focus-driven discussion guidance, structured decision-making and clear documentation of review outcomes
* Monitoring and tracking of agreed measures and follow-up actions including preparation and coordination of subsequent reviews to ensure sustainable implementation and goal achievement

* A completed technical degree in mechanical engineering or comparable
* Several years of professional experience in the field of quality and process management
* Fluency in German and English, both written and spoken
* Strong teamwork, communication and analytical skills in diverse and cross-functional environments

jobs.occupation: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.employer_name: Syddansk Universitet
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

• 
The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

• 
Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

• 
The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

• 
The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

• 
A strong track record for research fundraising is required.

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

• 
Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

• 
A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

• 
Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

• 
A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

• 
List of funded projects. 

• 
Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

• 
List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation.

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).
